checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals nonpayer-email-flow, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals nonpayer-email-flow.

checks.description: The flow is ordered and each message has trigger, segment, channel, and a copy variant ref.
checks.rule: Output flow lists ordered messages, each with id, trigger, segment, channel, copy_ref, and subject_ref.

checks.description: Each message references a QA-passed copy variant by id; the flow never writes copy.
checks.rule: Body states each message binds to a QA-passed copy-package variant id and that the flow sequences copy and does not write it.

checks.description: The offer, price, and promotion in the referenced copy trace exactly to the brief; nothing invented.
checks.rule: Body states the offer traces to the brief and forbids invented price, promotion, Skill Path title, or instructor name.

checks.description: Audience size is resolved from live data at send time, with about 18,000 as the planning estimate.
checks.rule: Body and output state audience_size is resolved at send, planning estimate about 18,000 non-payers.

checks.description: A one plain sentence send_on_approval describes what the send does and to how many.
checks.rule: Output includes a send_on_approval one-sentence statement of what the send does and to how many.

checks.description: Suppression excludes paying contacts, unsubscribes, and hard bounces.
checks.rule: Output suppression names paying contacts, unsubscribed, and hard-bounced, and the flow excludes them.

checks.description: The platform open item is surfaced; the package is not-sendable until confirmed and approved.
checks.rule: Body marks the platform open item and marks the package design-only and not-sendable until the platform is confirmed and approved.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals, empowering not deficit-framed, RTL-safe Arabic.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals; any Arabic example is empowering and RTL-safe.
